title: OpenAVX Configuration Schema
description: Production configuration schema for the Open Audio-Video eXchange (OpenAVX) media streaming architecture.

$schema.description: URL to the OpenAVX configuration JSON Schema.

network.description: Network adapter, interface binding, and peer coordination configuration.

bind_ip.description: Explicit local IPv4/IPv6 address or interface to bind TCP and multicast egress (e.g., '10.0.0.50' or 'eth1').

discovery_servers.description: List or comma-separated string of discovery/registration server endpoints (host:port).

peers.description: List or comma-separated string of explicit unicast peer addresses or hostnames.

sources.description: Stream publishing, subscription domains, and client limits.

groups.description: List or comma-separated string of announce groups/domains.

publish.description: Broadcast channels/groups this endpoint announces to.

subscribe.description: Channels/groups this endpoint discovers or subscribes to.

max_clients.description: Maximum simultaneous client connections per sender stream.

transports.description: Transport protocol and layer 3 multicast parameters.

prefix.description: Multicast group address prefix or CIDR block (e.g., '239.255.0.0/16').

netmask.description: Subnet netmask for multicast address allocation (e.g., '255.255.0.0').

servers.description: List or comma-separated string of discovery/registration server endpoints (host:port).

static_peers.description: List or comma-separated string of explicit unicast peer addresses or hostnames.

publish.description: List or comma-separated string of broadcast channels this endpoint announces to.

subscribe.description: List or comma-separated string of channels this endpoint subscribes to.

multicast.description: Layer 3 IP multicast transport parameters (alias taxonomy).

prefix.description: Multicast group address prefix or CIDR block (e.g., '239.255.0.0/16').

netmask.description: Subnet netmask for multicast address allocation (e.g., '255.255.0.0').
